Odisha Coast Faces New Cyclonic Threat After Cyclone Arnab

Days after Cyclone Arnab, the coast of Odisha is facing a new cyclonic threat. This fresh storm raises concerns about potential flooding and crop damage in the region. Following Cyclone Arnab, the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) and telecommunication companies have been working to restore services in cyclone-hit areas of Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
